description_en: Sets the HTTPS certificate for a specified domain name
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainCSRCertificate设置指定域名下的HTTPS证书
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-csr-certificate --server-certificate example-string --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDcdnDomainCSRCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The content of the signing certificate for the certificate signing request (CSR) that you created by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144478.html operation. The certificate must be in PEM format.

Base64-encode the certificate content. Then, use the built-in JavaScript function encodeURIComponent to encode the result before you pass the parameter
parameters.help_zh:
证书内容。该证书必须是通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144478.html接口创建的CSR对应的签名证书，内部必须是PEM格式的证书。
传参前先对证书Base64编码后再使用JavaScript内置函数encodeURIComponent进行编码处理
parameters.name: server_certificate

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for the certificate. The domain name must have HTTPS acceleration enabled
parameters.help_zh: 指定证书所属加速域名。需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name
